sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.subtitle: Outgoing mail captured instead of being delivered.
sandbox.empty_body: When sandbox capture is on, outgoing mail lands here instead of the wire.
sandbox.no_permission: You need sandbox permission to view captured mail.
sandbox.load_images_hint: Remote images are blocked by default.
sandbox.raw_missing: The raw body was not kept (for example system mail). Only the envelope is available.
sandbox.raw_partial: MIME was only partly understood — showing what we could parse plus the raw source.
sandbox.delete_body: The captured message will be removed. This cannot be undone.
